subject: general
question: Which social reformer founded the 'Brahmo Samaj’ in 1828 and became famous for his pioneering role in advocating education and opposing practices like Sati, child marriage and social division?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** founded the Brahmo Samaj in 1828.
 
• He is renowned for his efforts in advocating modern education, particularly for women.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a staunch opponent of social evils like Sati, child marriage, and the caste system.
 
• His reformist zeal earned him the title of the "Father of the Indian Renaissance."
 
• The Brahmo Samaj played a crucial role in the socio-religious reform movements in India during the 19th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** was born on 22nd May 1772 in Radhanagar, Bengal.
 
• He was a polyglot, proficient in multiple languages including Sanskrit, Persian, Arabic, English, and Bengali.
 
• In addition to founding the Brahmo Samaj, he also established the Atmiya Sabha in 1815 to campaign against social injustices.
 
• His efforts were instrumental in the abolition of Sati, leading to the enactment of the Sati Regulation Act in 1829 by the British government.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy's contributions extend to journalism, as he published several newspapers to disseminate his reformist ideas.
 
• He passed away on 27th September 1833 in Bristol, England, where he was on a visit to campaign for Indian rights and autonomy.
